channel.title: The Minnesota Star Tribune - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Minnesota Star Tribune (startribune.com)

item.title: Takeaways: Wild’s early goals hold up in 4-1 victory over Flames
item.description: They added a third-period insurance goal by Matt Boldy and got 29 saves from Filip Gustavsson to avoid overtime.

item.title: Roper: How Minnesota’s civic culture fueled a tough ICE resistance, took feds by surprise
item.description: It’s not pleasant for people to go toe-to-toe with the federal government. But in this case, it’s very Minnesotan.

item.title: AI image of Alex Pretti’s killing is the latest altered photo amid ICE surge in Minneapolis
item.description: Look closely, slow down, think critically before believing what you see on the internet, experts caution.

item.title: Takeaways: Timberwolves thump NBA-best Thunder 123-111 for third victory in a row
item.description: The Wolves started strong and didn’t let up for their second victory over the defending NBA champions this season.

item.title: Souhan: Despite leaving Twins broadcast booth, Dick Bremer still gets plenty of baseball
item.description: Bremer will go into the Twins Hall of Fame this summer and enjoys listening to his son’s play-by-play of minor league games.

item.title: Bemidji State University removes two deans from roles
item.description: Officials said the two weren’t fired, but they couldn’t share what prompted the removals. A union rep says the situation is unusual.

item.title: Minnesota man accused of attempting to free Luigi Mangione from jail in New York
item.description: Mark Anderson, 36, of Mankato, was found with a pizza cutter and barbeque fork.

item.title: Border Patrol’s Greg Bovino heads west from Minnesota after reassignment
item.description: The controversial Border Patrol commander was spotted in South Dakota and Wyoming this week after the White House shuffled responsibilities for its Minnesota ICE surge.

item.title: The latest: Trump now says ‘nothing will change’ on immigration enforcement in Minnesota
item.description: Border czar Tom Homan said a “withdrawal of law enforcement resources” is in the works. Trump indicated otherwise Thursday night.

item.title: Judge to weigh political motives in ICE surge
item.description: A federal judge has asked the Trump administration to respond to allegations from the state’s leaders that Operation Metro Surge is motivated by animosity toward Minnesota.
